newsitem.title: USA: Health Power sees profitable 2nd half '97.
newsitem.headline: Health Power sees profitable 2nd half '97.

text.p: Health Power Inc said Friday it expects continued profitability in the second half of 1997.
The company today reported its first quarterly profit since the second quarter of 1995, posting earnings of $0.44 a share, versus a loss $0.36 a share in the year-earlier period.

In a statement accompanying the release of second quarter earnings, president Thomas Beaty said: "We are very pleased with the results of the financial turnaround plan that was implemented last year with regard to the HMO operations and the results of the second quarter. We continue to anticipate profitability in the third and fourth quarters.
"With higher ADC Medicaid reimbursement rates effective July 1 and the exceptional growth of CompManagement's business, we look forward with confidence to the second half of 1997."
Health Power is a managed care holding company whose operating subsidiaries are Health Power HMO, CompManagement Inc and CompManagement Health Systems Inc.
